rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for jade as a gemstone or material.

example.english: I bought a piece of jade for my mother.
example.traditional: 我買咗一塊玉送畀阿媽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 faai3 juk6 sung3 bei2 aa3 maa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the characteristic green colour of jade rather than for the stone itself.

example.english: This cup is jade in colour and quite pretty.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 bui1 hai6 juk6 sik1 gei2 leng3 wo3

rows.note: Use this as the plant name when referring specifically to the jade plant.

example.english: The jade plant at home is growing very lush.
example.traditional: 我屋企盆玉樹生得好茂盛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 pun4 juk6 syu6 sang1 dak1 hou2 mau6 sing6
